ModMetaData.name: Ponies of the Rim — Flight Traits
ModMetaData.author: Snow storm
ModMetaData.description:
Flight Traits adds a collection of flight-focused personality traits and life stories for flying ponies in RimWorld.
Traits shape each pony’s aerial style: some are faster or can stay airborne longer, while others recover stamina more quickly or trade one advantage for a drawback. Powerful all-around flight traits are intentionally uncommon, so exceptional flyers stand out.
This add-on also gives selected Pegasus backstories flight-related modifiers. Rainbow Dash’s unique childhood and Wonderbolt career together provide approximately +30% flight speed, +40% maximum flight stamina, and +20% stamina recovery.
Flight modifiers apply through Ponies of the Rim’s flight system. Generation filtering is intended to keep flight-specific traits and stories exclusive to eligible flying pawns.
Requires RimWorld 1.6, Harmony, and Ponies of the Rim - Core.
REBALANCED FLIGHT TABLE (ALL RACES)
Race | Wing Type | Speed | Stamina | Recovery | Drain | Lore ------------|----------------------|-------|---------|----------|-------|----------------------------- Pegasus | Feathered, medium | 1.15 | 1.10 | 1.10 | 0.95 | Fast, agile Alicorn | Feathered, large | 0.95 | 1.35 | 1.15 | 0.85 | Powerful, enduring Batpony | Membranous, small | 1.35 | 0.75 | 0.90 | 1.25 | Nocturnal, fast, fragile Thestral | Membranous, small | 1.35 | 0.75 | 0.90 | 1.25 | Same as batpony Changeling | Membranous, magical | 1.00 | 1.15 | 1.25 | 0.85 | Magical, efficient Griffon | Feathered, large | 1.05 | 0.95 | 0.95 | 1.05 | Strong, but heavy Hippogriff | Feathered, medium | 1.10 | 1.05 | 1.05 | 0.95 | Versatile
Parameter explanations: - Speed — flight speed multiplier (flightSpeedFactor). - Stamina — maximum time in the air without landing (maxStaminaFactor). - Recovery — how fast stamina regenerates on the ground (recoveryFactor). - Drain — how quickly stamina is consumed in flight (staminaDrainFactor).
Values above 1.0 are buffs; values below 1.0 are debuffs.
